note: GK-GAP-003: a well-typed conditional expression in three shapes -- bigint arms (d = |x - threshold|), ByteString arms (t = highTag or lowTag) and a ternary nested in the else arm (b = 2 / 1 / 0 for above / at / below). Every arm of every ternary is taken by at least one accepted spend, and each arm is also given the OTHER arm's value so a swapped or merged branch is refused. The interpreter verdict is asserted equal to the real @bsv/sdk Spend verdict on every row; vmErrorPattern pins which assert refused.

spends.note: x above threshold: every ternary takes its THEN arm (d = x - threshold = 5, t = highTag, b = 2).
x below threshold: every ternary takes its ELSE arm, and the nested ternary its inner ELSE arm (d = threshold - x = 6, t = lowTag, b = 0).
x at threshold: the nested ternary takes its inner THEN arm (b = 1); d = 0 and t = lowTag via the outer ELSE arms.

spends.vmErrorPattern: OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY requires the top stack item to be truthy
spends.note: bigint arms swapped: -5 is the ELSE arm's value (threshold - x) while x is above the threshold.

spends.vmErrorPattern: OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY requires the top stack item to be truthy
spends.note: bigint arms swapped the other way: -6 is the THEN arm's value (x - threshold) while x is below.

spends.vmErrorPattern: OP_EQUALVERIFY requires the top two stack items to be equal
spends.note: ByteString arms swapped: highTag while x is below the threshold.

spends.vmErrorPattern: OP_EQUALVERIFY requires the top two stack items to be equal
spends.note: ByteString arms swapped: lowTag while x is above the threshold.

spends.vmErrorPattern: The top stack element must be truthy after script evaluation
spends.note: nested ternary: 0 is the inner ELSE arm's value while x is AT the threshold (wants 1).

spends.vmErrorPattern: The top stack element must be truthy after script evaluation
spends.note: nested ternary: 1 is the inner THEN arm's value while x is above (the outer THEN arm wants 2).
